informal_statement:
For a one-sided circular cap of chord length \(L>0\) with chord midpoint \((m,b)\), if
\[
p_y=b
\]
and
\[
|p_x-m|<L/2,
\]
then \(p\) is not on its selected circular arc trace.
reason: Source `CMVElementaryGeometry.lean:428-441`: Strict chord displacement excludes the circle trace using the chord-radius identity; the two chord endpoints are correctly excluded from the premise.
